visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-bleed background video (with poster-image fallback) and overlaid heading, text and CTAs
visualCharacteristics.layout: Media fills the block; text left-center over it; play/pause toggle bottom-right
visualCharacteristics.interactions: Video autoplays muted and looping when near the viewport (skipped with prefers-reduced-motion); play/pause button

contentPattern.structure: row 1 = background media: a link to an .mp4/.webm video plus an optional poster image (the poster is also the fallback); row 2 = heading (H1 or H2), paragraph(s), CTA links

usage: Hero banners and promo bands with a background video, e.g. the homepage hero and the Electromobility banner.
reuseGuidance: Use for any section whose background is a video. For a still image with a boxed card, use hero-card-overlay. Optional page metadata video-play-label / video-pause-label localize the toggle.
